Control quickhack · ◆ Quiet · DV8 · Cooldown 6 Rounds · 1 slot

The GM picks 3 pieces of their chrome (not cyberarms, legs, eyes, audio suite, Neuroport or Cybersuite; options in them count). Off for 20 Rounds. Also works on a drone or turret that isn't on an architecture: 3d6 to it.

Interface + 1d10 vs DV8. 500eb (Expensive). Cyberpunk: The Unification Era, Core Rules Chapter 10.
